Chapter 1152: Chapter 17: The Secret of the Magic Jade (Please Subscribe)

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan watched carefully as the Moyu Tower Master reformed in the distance.

He was ready to concede and exit the ninth layer of the Black Tower at any moment.

First, because he had just exploded his external universe and was temporarily in a weakened state.

Second, although the current Moyu Tower Master didn’t have the same level of energy fluctuation as initially,

the threat he posed to Lin Yuan was greater. Even if he did nothing and just stood there, there was a sense of sole dominance over time and space.

"Not bad."

The Moyu Tower Master stared at Lin Yuan for a moment, then smiled.

"Not bad?" Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

According to the Six-Armed Figure Shen Ji, the imprint left by the Moyu Tower Master on the ninth layer was merely a kind of fixed ’program’.

But now?

He had actually said ’not bad’, a statement with personal emotional evaluation?

"Very good."

The Moyu Tower Master continued to look for a while and made another remark.

"Senior?" Lin Yuan tentatively called out.

Although he didn’t know what state the Moyu Tower Master was in, since the other party didn’t attack immediately, he likely bore no malice?

"Rest assured, you passed the ninth layer of the Black Tower."

The Moyu Tower Master smiled slightly, "I am now essentially a strand of consciousness left behind by my past self, completely severed from the true self. However, upon awakening, the connection reestablished, it won’t be long before I fall into another time loop."

Lin Yuan was secretly shocked at these words.

Indeed.

The present Moyu Tower Master is more than just an unemotional ’imprint’.

It is a strand of consciousness.

This consciousness is different from the ’soul division’ of the Tuolong Great Saint.

The soul division is a new life form, albeit with the same memories as the original body.

But consciousness... is still considered the Moyu Tower Master.

In fact, many Chaos Great Saints are reluctant to leave behind such a thing as a soul division.

The more powerful the Great Saint, the more so.

A soul division without power, when in the hands of some Great Saints, often meets a poor fate.

...

Given that this consciousness still belongs to the Moyu Tower Master, even with a brief revival, it will quickly fall back into a time loop.

The time loop encountered when the twelfth layer attempts to break through to the thirteenth layer is a test from the Chaos Void, unavoidable by any means for the same being.

"You should have cultivated the foundational legacy of that being? No, not quite, it’s somewhat different, did you merge with other same-tier legacies?"

"Merging different thirteenth-layer legacies... very impressive."

The Moyu Tower Master observed Lin Yuan, asking with interest.

The imprint he left, after just contending with Lin Yuan,

even at the terrifying power when he exploded his external universe, the Moyu Tower Master saw it all.

Thus, the information gathered was far more than those special beings observing Lin Yuan from afar outside the Xuanhuang Universe in his battle with the Black Light Great Saint and the Dual Origin Great Saint.

In the clash between Lin Yuan and the Black Light Great Saint, the Dual Origin Great Saint, neither used their full strength,

not even fully activating the external universe, much less exploding it.

Of course, the Black Light Great Saint, the Dual Origin Great Saint also did not use their true lethal means, they didn’t even enter the Xuanhuang Universe, naturally avoiding an all-out fight.

"I was also just lucky..." Lin Yuan immediately said.

He was not surprised that the Moyu Tower Master discerned his cultivation of "Infinite Void".

At the level of a peerless Great Saint, a thirteenth-layer legacy isn’t that much of a secret,

but the Moyu Tower Master being able to see his fusion of other thirteenth-layer methods slightly startled Lin Yuan.

This implied that the Moyu Tower Master had a deep understanding of "Infinite Void", aware of its power scope.

"There is no such thing as luck." The Moyu Tower Master smiled, "Cultivating a thirteenth-layer legacy is incredibly difficult, had I not slain that wondrous life form back then, I wouldn’t have reached the threshold for cultivating that thirteenth-layer legacy."

"Senior also cultivated a thirteenth-layer legacy?" Lin Yuan looked at the Moyu Tower Master and said.

He understood the terror of a thirteenth-layer legacy, having reached a level in the Dominator Realm to stand shoulder to shoulder with Chaos Great Saints, though it wasn’t solely due to "Infinite Void".

But this thirteenth-layer legacy that elevated Lin Yuan’s foundation to a terrifying degree definitely played an important role.

The Moyu Tower Master as a peerless Great Saint, in addition to having cultivated some kind of thirteenth-layer legacy, how truly powerful must he be?

Perhaps not sweeping away other peerless Great Saints, but probably close.

"The most difficult part of a thirteenth-layer legacy is its cultivation, not its acquisition." The Moyu Tower Master smiled, "With your current power, once you reach perfection in the Chaos Realm, your strength might even surpass mine."

Lin Yuan obediently listened, and according to his own estimations, this was indeed so.

If Lin Yuan could step into perfection in the Chaos Realm, ordinary peerless Great Saints would simply not be his match.

By then, those able to pose even a slight threat to Lin Yuan were likely only those other peerless Great Saints who also cultivated a thirteenth-layer legacy, or those special peerless Great Saints?

But even then, it would be only a slight threat, as Lin Yuan had too many trump cards and methods.

...

"Back when this Black Tower was built, the intention was to nurture a Chaos Great Saint, but during my lifetime, that never happened. Yet, after falling into a time loop, one eventually emerged..."

The Moyu Tower Master looked around with a slightly sentimental tone.

During the prime of the Magic Jade Tower, the Moyu Tower Master, as an invincible Great Saint sweeping through the Chaos Void, indeed had some Chaos Great Saints and even peerless Great Saints pledge allegiance.

But these Chaos Great Saints and peerless Great Saints were outsiders, not direct descendants of the Magic Jade Tower, lacking even the qualification to enter this Demon Jade Space, let alone challenge the nine layers of the Black Tower.
